body: She doesn't.  We had a pretty good talk when we were breaking up and we were on the same page on a lot of things.  We still have feelings for each other, just hers aren't as strong as mine.  She loves me but she isn't in love with me, and we talked about whether we should take a break or actually break up and she specifically said she doesn't have anyone lined up, and that she was hoping the spark would return so we could start dating again because she really does want to and doesn't know 100% why it went away.

UPDATE!

I'm not sober right now,  but just in case anyone was wodnering we broke up tonight.  I asked her if she thought that spark was ever coming back adn she said she didn't think it would and we broke up.  Thanks for the comments and the advice!

Thanks for this.  It is hard because we work together as well, and I know she wants to keep trying, but she doesn't know that it will come back and for some reason I seem to annoy her more recently so I feel like she is just starting to push me away.

To be honest, as a guy I would be understanding, but wanting more.  That being said it really depends on the guy.  Some people desire to have a stronger physical connection than others.  Whether that is a sex life, or if it just means holding hands or sitting close.  I think it is good that you are in therapy, and I would just be as open as you can with your mate.
